summary: This study tests a digital diet app called NutriSteppe for adults who have type 2 diabetes, obesity, or overweight with other health conditions. The sponsor, Kazakh Academy of Nutrition, is enrolling 120 participants for this No phase study. Participants are already receiving a type of medication called a GLP-1 receptor agonist from their doctors. The trial is currently Recruiting and compares standard care alone to standard care combined with the NutriSteppe app.
